items.question: What is the tax rate on the annual taxable income of foreign banks operating in Dubai under Law No. 1 of 2024?
items.gold: 20 per cent of their annual taxable income.
items.fact: Foreign banks in Dubai pay 20 per cent tax on annual taxable income.

items.question: Does the UAE levy income tax on individuals?
items.gold: No, the UAE does not levy income tax on individuals.
items.fact: The UAE does not levy income tax on individuals.
